sloka: प्रतिज्ञातः त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्य वासिनाम् ।ऋषीणाम् रक्षणार्थाय वधः संयति रक्षसाम् ॥३-९-१०॥
transliteration: pratijñātaḥ tvayā vīra daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām ।ṛṣīṇām rakṣaṇārthāya vadhaḥ saṁyati rakṣasām ॥3-9-10॥

translations.english: O valiant one, you have promised to kill the demons in the battle, in order to protect the sages residing in the Dandaka forest.
